component.name: DeskAI
component.summary: A dock with focus modes, an inbox and desk restore

description.p: DeskAI is a dock for GNOME that helps you stay on what you're doing, and brings your desk back after a logout.

ul.li: Focus modes, each with its own apps, allowed sites and notification rules
An inbox on the dock for WhatsApp messages and AI agents such as Claude Code
A command bar: press Super+/ and type what you want, in plain words
A status dot for your dev servers and database, with a restart and their log
After a logout, your windows, terminals and dev servers come back as they were

description.p: After installing, DeskAI Setup opens by itself and takes you through the rest.
Easier to set up and to keep up to date, and one dock only.
Lebih gampang dipasang dan di-update, dan dock-nya cuma satu.

ul.li: Updating takes one click: a list of what's new and one button, and everything you chose stays as it is.
Update cukup sekali klik: daftar yang baru dan satu tombol, dan semua pilihan kamu tetap.
DeskAI Setup opens by itself once the package is installed.
DeskAI Setup kebuka sendiri begitu paketnya terpasang.
Setup can download the local AI for you, Ollama and its model, in the background. It says how big it is first, and you can say no.
Setup bisa download AI lokal buat kamu, Ollama dan modelnya, di belakang. Ukurannya dikasih tau dulu, dan kamu bisa nolak.
DeskAI stays your only dock. Another dock that comes back on goes off again, and removing DeskAI brings them back.
DeskAI tetap jadi satu-satunya dock. Dock lain yang nyala lagi langsung dimatiin, dan kalau DeskAI dihapus, dock itu balik lagi.
Fixed: two docks on top of each other until the next login, after turning on Ubuntu Dock in the Extensions app.
Diperbaiki: dua dock numpuk sampai login berikutnya, setelah Ubuntu Dock dinyalain dari app Extensions.
Uninstalling the package also removes DeskAI for whoever's logged in, so nobody ends up with no dock.
Uninstall paketnya sekalian menghapus DeskAI buat yang lagi login, jadi nggak ada yang kehilangan dock.

description.p: Steadier, and it keeps out of what it wasn't asked to touch.
Lebih stabil, dan nggak nyentuh yang nggak diminta.

ul.li: Apps DeskAI opened keep running when its background service restarts or crashes.
App yang dibuka DeskAI tetap jalan kalau layanan latarnya restart atau crash.
Locking the screen no longer empties the inbox, and what AI agents say meanwhile waits for you.
Ngunci layar nggak lagi ngosongin inbox, dan kabar dari AI agent selama dikunci nunggu kamu balik.
The command bar understands being told not to, asks before stopping everything, and reads a mistyped project name right away.
Kolom perintah ngerti kalau dilarang, nanya dulu sebelum nyetop semuanya, dan langsung ngerti nama project yang salah ketik.
Closing a project asks before stopping a database DeskAI didn't start, and everyday words no longer close a project that has them in its name.
Nutup project nanya dulu sebelum nyetop database yang bukan dinyalain DeskAI, dan kata sehari-hari nggak lagi nutup project yang namanya mirip.
Fewer false alarms about distractions, and a guess takes more than a site's name.
Lebih jarang salah nuduh ke-distract, dan nebak butuh lebih dari sekadar nama situs.
A mistake in modes.json gets a card saying where it is, the last version that worked stays in use, and a file that can't be read is copied before anything saves over it.
Salah tulis di modes.json dikasih tau lewat kartu, versi terakhir yang bener tetap dipakai, dan file yang nggak kebaca disalin dulu sebelum ditimpa.
Hooks in AI agents are off unless you turn them on, and removing DeskAI puts their settings and what else it changed back as they were.
Hook di AI agent mati kecuali kamu nyalain, dan menghapus DeskAI ngembaliin pengaturannya dan yang lain kayak semula.
Clicking the app you're in on the dock minimizes all its windows on this workspace, and clicking again brings them all back
A suggestion leaves the dock after a minute, and clicking Files then still takes you there
The command bar handles much more casual English and Indonesian without AI
Icons of apps that aren't pinned keep their place on the dock
Focus stats are deleted after 90 days, and the dock's own files are readable only by you
No gray flash at login on Ubuntu
Installs on GNOME 51, where the smooth login stays out of the way. Checked against GNOME 51's source, not run on it yet
Servers keep their status after whatever started them has exited
A smooth login: the animation plays once your desktop and extensions have loaded
Music on the dock, with previous, pause and next
The first time someone new is held during a focus mode, the dock asks once whether they always get through
Plain requests in English or Indonesian run instantly in the command bar, with no AI
Status dots for servers you started yourself, and closing a project asks before stopping them
Break reminders after two hours without a pause
Restoring a large desk gives its windows more time and keeps them at their saved size
Can run fully on your computer with Ollama, and carries on with it when Claude stops working
Most decisions no longer need a model: built-in lists and a small classifier trained on your corrections
Close a project from the command bar: its servers stop, and you choose what happens to its terminals
Say what the window in front of you is: "this is work" or "this is a distraction"
The command bar forgives typos in project and server names
Command bar: press Super+/ and type what you want
The dev servers and database on your desk get a status dot, a restart and their log
A short guide the first time the dock runs
Fixed: the desk wasn't offered back after a reboot, and Chrome came back without its launcher's flags
